shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git status --short && find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(TextArea|TextInput|Button).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -25; cat tsconfig.json; git status --short; find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/react-markdown/readme.md | head -100; rg -n 'skipHtml|urlTransform|Security' node_modules/react-markdown/readme.md; cat index.html; ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer'"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -d /root/.cache/ms-playwright/* /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/* /home/sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/* 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'g-color-base-brand|g-color-text-brand' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -4; git diff --stat; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' src/App.tsx; sed -n '1,65p' src/styles.css; npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'id; command -v sudo; command -v apt-get; cat /etc/os-release; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | head; ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | head'

/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell | rg 'not found'; apt-cache policy libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libnspr4 libasound2"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/markdown-browser-libs && cd /tmp/markdown-browser-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libdrm-common && for deb in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" root; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/markdown-browser-libs && apt-get download libxrender1 libwayland-server0 libxi6 && for deb in libxrender1*.deb libwayland-server0*.deb libxi6*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" root; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/markdown-browser-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core && for deb in libsqlite3-0*.deb fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" root; done'

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'JS'
const fs=require('fs');const p='/tmp/check-markdown.cjs';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(\"await page.goto('http://localhost:5173');\", \"page.setDefaultTimeout(10000);\\n  await page.route('https://**/*', route => route.abort());\\n  await page.goto('http://localhost:5173', {waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});\\n  console.log('Page loaded');\");fs.writeFileSync(p,s);
JS
FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/markdown-browser-libs/root/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/markdown-browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/markdown-browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-markdown.cjs"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/markdown-fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/markdown-browser-libs/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/markdown-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
node - <<'"'JS'
const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/check-markdown.cjs','utf8');s=s.replace(\"assert.equal(await preview.locator('h2').textContent(), 'Заголовок');\", \"console.log(await input.inputValue()); console.log(await preview.innerHTML()); await page.screenshot({path:'/tmp/markdown-debug.png',fullPage:true}); assert.equal(await preview.locator('h2').textContent(), 'Заголовок');\");fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/check-markdown-debug.cjs',s);
JS
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/markdown-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/markdown-browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/markdown-browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/check-markdown-debug.cjs"
